d: In this video, Firstpost explains how just two days of unrest during France's cost-of-living protests could cost insurers €207 million ($227 million). The violence on 17 and 18 October triggered 5,280 insurance claims, with businesses accounting for nearly 95 per cent of the estimated damage. The losses are comparable to France's 2005 riots and the 2018-2019 Yellow Vest movement, despite those episodes lasting weeks or months. Meanwhile, the French government is offering grants of up to €10,000 ($10,970) and interest-free loans of up to €50,000 ($54,850) to help affected small businesses…
